description: This file defines a Smarty compiler plugin for the 'assign' function, allowing templates to assign values to variables during compilation. It contains the implementation of 'smarty_compiler_assign', which parses attributes and generates PHP code to perform the assignment.

methods.name: smarty_compiler_assign
methods.description: Compiler function plugin that processes the 'assign' tag in Smarty templates, parsing attributes and generating code to assign a value to a template variable.
